insights.summary: When the AI Voice Agent transfers to a live agent, the details it collected do not arrive, so callers repeat themselves.
insights.quote: The note that's supposed to land with the call is empty. There's a note field, it's blank.

insights.summary: Customer links "ai voice agent handoff loses context" to the renewal decision.
insights.quote: My boss asked me last week, point blank, whether we're renewing. And this handoff thing, the agent losing the context, that's the first thing I thought of.
